06 — TensorFlow: Spectrogram ConvNets

Chapter 6 · local only (TensorFlow required; not on GitHub Pages WASM). Predict MDD vs Control from the spectral signature of music vs tones.

🔬 Hypothesis

A Conv2D on STFT spectrograms of BOLD is more accurate on music blocks than tones. Expected pattern: Music-only evaluation shows a clear lift — stimulus-specific deficit signal.
Music has rich spectral structure. We predict controls show elevated high-frequency power and stronger auditory–limbic coherence during positive music. MDD (anhedonia) exhibits blunted responses.
